results_due: mid-January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (13-29 Oct)
reasoning: The MD said FY27 revenue should reach ₹715-725 Cr 'at the least'. H1 was ₹354 Cr, so H2 needs at least ₹361-371 Cr. Q2 alone was ₹207 Cr, so the guide is a floor.
Skid capacity goes from 12,000 to 15,000 units a year by December and skids are guided at ₹150-200 Cr for the year. We assume revenue grows about 6% on Q2.
EBITDA margin has sat at 23-24% for four quarters; management talks of about 25%. PAT includes the depreciation change that lowered depreciation by about ₹8 Cr a quarter.
risks: Visibility is only about three months
Skid revenue depends on one customer in India
